# Ezekiel 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** "And-you, son-of man, take for-yourself a-sword sharp; [as] a-razor-of [the]-barbers you-shall-take-it for-yourself, and-pass-it over your-head and-over your-beard, and-take for-yourself scales-of weighing and-divide-them.

**2** A-third in-the-fire you-shall-burn in-the-midst-of the-city when-are-fulfilled the-days-of the-siege; and-you-shall-take the-third, you-shall-strike with-the-sword all-around-it; and-the-third you-shall-scatter to-the-wind, and-a-sword I-will-draw-out after-them.

**3** And-you-shall-take from-there a-few in-number, and-bind-them in-your-skirts.

**4** And-from-them again you-shall-take and-cast-them into the-midst-of the-fire and-burn-them in-the-fire; from-it shall-go-forth a-fire to-all the-house-of Israel."

**5** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "This [is] Jerusalem — in-the-midst-of the-nations I-have-set-her, and-countries all-around-her.

**6** And-she-rebelled against-My-judgments in-wickedness more-than the-nations, and-against-My-statutes more-than the-countries which [are] all-around-her; for My-judgments they-rejected, and-My-statutes — they-did-not-walk in-them."

**7** Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Because you-have-been-more-turbulent than the-nations which [are] all-around-you — in-My-statutes you-have-not-walked, and-My-judgments you-have-not-done, and-according-to the-judgments-of the-nations which [are] all-around-you you-have-not-done" —

**8** therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Behold, I — even-I — [am] against-you, and-I-will-execute judgments in-your-midst before-the-eyes-of the-nations.

**9** And-I-will-do in-you what I-have-not-done and-the-like-of-which I-will-not-do again, because-of all your-abominations.

**10** Therefore fathers shall-eat sons in-your-midst, and-sons shall-eat their-fathers; and-I-will-execute judgments against-you, and-I-will-scatter all your-remnant to-every wind.

**11** "And-I-will-diminish-you, and-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I also will-have-no-pity, for-all your-abominations," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**12** "And-I-will-diminish-you, and-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I also will-have-no-pity, for-all your-abominations," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**13** "And-I-will-diminish-you, and-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I also will-have-no-pity, for-all your-abominations," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**14** "And-I-will-diminish-you, and-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I also will-have-no-pity, for-all your-abominations," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**15** And-it-shall-be a-reproach and-a-taunt, a-warning and-a-horror to-the-nations which [are] all-around-you, when-I-execute judgments against-you in-anger and-in-fury and-in-rebukes-of fury — I, YHWH, have-spoken.

**16** When-I-send against-them the-evil arrows-of famine which shall-be for-destruction, which I-will-send to-destroy-you, and-famine I-will-increase upon-you, and-I-will-break for-you [the]-staff-of bread.

**17** And-I-will-send upon-you famine and-evil beasts, and-they-shall-bereave-you; and-pestilence and-blood shall-pass through-you; and-[the]-sword I-will-bring upon-you — I, YHWH, have-spoken.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **5:1-2**: The hair-shaving sign-act: hair symbolizes life/identity. Three portions represent Jerusalem's three fates: fire (siege), sword (battle), wind (exile). The razor-as-sword blurs instrument of grooming with instrument of death.

- **5:5**: Betokh ha-goyim samtihah — 'in the midst of the nations I set her.' Jerusalem's centrality is both privilege and responsibility. Her sin is worse because of her position.

- **5:10**: Avot yokhelu vanim — 'fathers shall eat sons.' Cannibalism during siege (cf. 2 Kgs 6:28-29, Lam 4:10) — the ultimate reversal of parental care.

— EMET
